blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The PNP-Highway Patrol Group (PNP-HPG) is deploying 716 officers to escort visiting leaders and delegates at the 49th ASEAN Summit and its related events in Manila. The agency announced its preparations on Wednesday during a joint press conference with the Department of Transportation (DOTr) and the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).
